data.summary:
Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of progressive experience across P&C Insurance, Banking & Payments, and Finance & Treasury domains. Deep expertise in SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, MX/ISO 20022), Vostro & Nostro account management, correspondent banking, payment lifecycle management, and treasury operations. Proven track record in P&C Insurance (Policy Administration, Claims Management, Billing, Underwriting), digital transformation, and AI-powered workflow automation. Strong experience in requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD/SRS documentation, Agile/Scrum delivery, stakeholder management, and UAT execution. Adept at translating complex business processes into precise technical specifications that deliver measurable ROI. Familiar with core banking platforms (Finacle, T24/Temenos, FIS), insurance policy systems, and CRM platforms (Zendesk). Certified SAFe Agilist (in progress) and CBAP (pursuing).
Key Domains: P&C Insurance (Policy, Claims, Billing, Underwriting)  •  SWIFT/MT/MX Payments  •  ISO 20022 / SEPA / RTGS  •  Nostro/Vostro/Correspondent Banking  •  Treasury & Cash Management  •  Trade Finance  •  HRMS  •  E-Commerce

responsibilities: Performed AS-IS/TO-BE gap analysis identifying $11M ROI opportunity through intelligent workflow optimization and process reengineering across insurance operations
Capital Markets / Investment Banking
Gathered and documented business requirements for Investment Banking and Capital Markets applications supporting Office operations.
Analyzed the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture, execution, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.
Collaborated with traders, portfolio managers, operations, risk, finance, and compliance teams to translate business needs into functional requirements.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and RTMs for Equities, Fixed Income, FX, and Derivatives trading platforms.

Developed business capability maps across Trade Processing, Settlement, Reconciliation, Risk, Finance and Operations to identify capability gaps, ownership dependencies and opportunities for process transformation.

Created end-to-end customer/user journey maps for banking and investment workflows, mapping key touchpoints, business interactions, hand-offs, pain points and exception scenarios to identify opportunities for improved service delivery and operational efficiency.
Supported UAT by preparing test scenarios, validating trade workflows, coordinating defect resolution, and obtaining business sign-off.
Worked with regulatory teams to align solutions with Basel III, AML/KYC requirements.
Documented business rules for trade validation, exception handling, corporate actions, and securities settlement.
Worked on portfolio management, position management, cash reconciliation, P&L reporting, and exposure monitoring requirements.
Banking, Payments & SWIFT Integration
Gathered and documented business requirements for payment gateway integrations including SWIFT MT/MX messaging standards, payment authorization flows, and settlement processing pipelines
Documented Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation processes, correspondent banking workflows, and automated matching rules for payment exception handling and dispute resolution
Collaborated with development and integration teams to define API contracts for payment gateway connectivity, ensuring compliance with PCI-DSS, banking regulations, and SWIFT network standards

Designed Target Operating Models for cross-border payment processes, defining future-state processes, roles and responsibilities, operational controls, system interactions and governance across payment initiation, processing, settlement and reconciliation.

Mapped end-to-end payment customer journeys covering payment initiation, beneficiary validation, authorization, screening, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception/repair handling, identifying customer and operational pain points.

Developed business capability maps for Payments, covering payment initiation, payment processing, sanctions/compliance, clearing & settlement, reconciliation, investigation and reporting capabilities, and assessed gaps between current and target-state capabilities.
Performed TOM and capability gap assessments to identify opportunities for payment process standardization, automation, straight-through processing and improved operational controls.
AI, Automation & Digital Transformation
Defined requirements for ML-powered intelligent routing engine: predictive claim routing, fraud detection patterns, automated underwriting decisioning, and payment anomaly detection capabilities
Specified acceptance criteria for AI/ML models including accuracy thresholds, performance benchmarks, data governance requirements, and regulatory explainability standards
Supported CRM workflow improvements via Zendesk: ticket routing automation, SLA tracking configuration, and integration specifications with insurance/banking platforms
Stakeholder Management & Agile Delivery
Served as primary liaison across business stakeholders, product owners, dev teams, QA, and C-level executives; facilitated JAD sessions, design reviews, UAT, and sprint ceremonies
Managed 100+ user story backlog aligned to business objectives; achieved 95%+ sprint commitment accuracy through refined estimation, capacity planning, and story clarity
Reduced sprint spillover by 30% and improved velocity by 18% within first quarter through impediment removal, workflow optimization, and requirement standardization
Delivered 5 major releases with 98% pre-production defect identification rate; accelerated time-to-market by 3 weeks through zero-rework requirements delivery
